title: UnsupportedOperationException with HTTP Response Code 204
body:
### Describe the bug

Since Quarkus 3.28 the response code 204 (NO CONTENT) ends up in an UnsupportedOperationException using quarkus-rest.

Code:
`return Response.status(Response.Status.NO_CONTENT).build();`
`return Response.status(204).build();  // same behavior`

### Expected behavior

The response code works without any exception.

### Actual behavior

see description

### How to Reproduce?

Just implement a REST endpoint with this one code line mentioned in the description and call the endpoint.

### Output of `uname -a` or `ver`

Windows 10.0.22631.5909

### Output of `java -version`

openjdk version "21" 2023-09-19

### Mandrel or GraalVM version (if different from Java)

_No response_

### Quarkus version or git rev

3.28.3

### Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`)

apache Maven 3.9.7
